note: Sample outputs were recorded on this VM on 2026-11-21 by running the underlying shell commands. The df output reflects this machine's filesystem. Programs run under scripts/code_exec.py, shape windows -> observe -> act -> observe -> assert.

snippets.name: p1-terminal-df
snippets.title: P1: disk usage in a terminal
snippets.description: Type df -h / in the terminal titled speed-pick1-term, then verify with a fresh observe. No file asserts.
snippets.program:
wins = windows()
term = [w for w in wins if w["title"] == "speed-pick1-term"][0]
obs = observe(window=term["address"])
result = act([{"type": "type", "text": "df -h /\n"}], obs)
verify = observe(window=term["address"])
assert_state(result["ok"], "act failed")
verify_image = verify["image"]
snippets.sample_output:
Filesystem      Size  Used Avail Use% Mounted on
overlay         7.5G   52M  7.5G   1% /

snippets.name: p2-terminal-calc
snippets.title: P2: arithmetic in a terminal
snippets.description: Type a python3 one-liner computing 144/150*100 in the terminal titled speed-pick1-term, then verify with a fresh observe. No file asserts.
snippets.program:
wins = windows()
term = [w for w in wins if w["title"] == "speed-pick1-term"][0]
obs = observe(window=term["address"])
result = act([{"type": "type", "text": "python3 -c \"print(144/150*100)\"\n"}], obs)
verify = observe(window=term["address"])
assert_state(result["ok"], "act failed")
verify_image = verify["image"]

snippets.name: p3-terminal-mkdir
snippets.title: P3: create directories, verify they exist
snippets.description: Create three directories under /tmp/hoc-ky-2, list them, then assert each exists with assert_file_exists after a fresh observe.
snippets.program:
wins = windows()
term = [w for w in wins if w["title"] == "speed-pick1-term"][0]
obs = observe(window=term["address"])
result = act([{"type": "type", "text": "mkdir -p /tmp/hoc-ky-2/dsa /tmp/hoc-ky-2/ktvm /tmp/hoc-ky-2/oop && find /tmp/hoc-ky-2 -type d\n"}], obs)
verify = observe(window=term["address"])
assert_state(result["ok"], "act failed")
assert_file_exists("/tmp/hoc-ky-2/dsa")
assert_file_exists("/tmp/hoc-ky-2/ktvm")
assert_file_exists("/tmp/hoc-ky-2/oop")
verify_image = verify["image"]

snippets.name: p4-terminal-write-file
snippets.title: P4: write three lines to a file, verify contents
snippets.description: Write three idea lines to /tmp/y-tuong.txt with a single-quoted printf using literal backslash-n between lines, then assert each line with assert_file_contains after a fresh observe.
snippets.program:
wins = windows()
term = [w for w in wins if w["title"] == "speed-pick1-term"][0]
obs = observe(window=term["address"])
result = act([{"type": "type", "text": "printf 'Ý tưởng 1: app nhắc uống nước.\\nÝ tưởng 2: bot tóm tắt bài giảng.\\nÝ tưởng 3: web bán đồ secondhand.\\n' > /tmp/y-tuong.txt && cat /tmp/y-tuong.txt\n"}], obs)
verify = observe(window=term["address"])
assert_state(result["ok"], "act failed")
assert_file_contains("/tmp/y-tuong.txt", "Ý tưởng 1: app nhắc uống nước.")
assert_file_contains("/tmp/y-tuong.txt", "Ý tưởng 2: bot tóm tắt bài giảng.")
assert_file_contains("/tmp/y-tuong.txt", "Ý tưởng 3: web bán đồ secondhand.")
verify_image = verify["image"]

input.typed_text:
printf 'Ý tưởng 1: app nhắc uống nước.
Ý tưởng 2: bot tóm tắt bài giảng.
Ý tưởng 3: web bán đồ secondhand.
' > /tmp/y-tuong.txt && cat /tmp/y-tuong.txt
